Split from https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/800#issuecomment-799773638

Current [12.5.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x20-V12-Files-Resources.md#v125-file-download):
> Verify that the web tier is configured to serve only files with specific file extensions to prevent unintentional information and source code leakage. For example, backup files (e.g. .bak), temporary working files (e.g. .swp), compressed files (.zip, .tar.gz, etc) and other extensions commonly used by editors should be blocked unless required.

Problem: category is "File download", but requirement description is more configuration oriented (than files served by an application).

Proposal: move to category [14.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v143-unintended-security-disclosure) Unintended Security Disclosure
title: Proposal: move 12.5.1 "serve only files with specific file extensions" to V14.3 Unintended Security Disclosure
